title: POST /api/unzip lands extracted files after the antivirus scan without re-checking the account, rights or quota owner
description: With the antivirus on, unzip extracts to a staging folder, awaits gate() per file, then creates the destination and moves the tree in. need(zip,write), quotaUserOf and the user come from before the scan and are not re-checked. Reproduced in a sandbox with a pausing fake clamd: (a) permissions lowered to read during the scan: unzip still 200 and p/a.txt, p/b.txt landed, while a new unzip gave 403; (b) account deleted during the scan: 200 and the files landed in the orphaned home; (c) deleted and re-created with adoptHome during the scan: 200 and files landed in the new account's home. Charging of the new account's quota was not observed (usage read 0).
root_cause: No findUser/createdAt/need/quotaUserOf recheck between the gate loop and mkdirSync/moveTree/hold.commit in the unzip handler.
intended_behavior: Like PUT /api/content: after the scan re-resolve the account, compare createdAt, re-run need(write) and use the current quota owner; refuse with 401/403 and land nothing otherwise.

trace.description: need(zip,write) and quotaUserOf(a,user) fixed at request start
await gate() per extracted file: the window for revocation
moveTree into the claimed folder, then hold.commit at 425 with the stale quota owner

evidence.description: PUT /api/content re-checks account instance, need(write), same path and quota owner after the scan
unzip claims the folder and moves files in with no such check

conditions.description: antivirus enabled so the staged scan window exists
caller held zip/write when the request started; rights removed or account deleted/replaced during the scan
the change must fall inside the scan of the extracted files

execution.attacker_perspective: A user whose rights are being removed, or an in-flight request of a deleted account.
payloads: POST /api/unzip {"space":"home","path":"/p.zip"} with a 2-file zip while a fake clamd holds the first scan; meanwhile admin PUT /api/admin/users/zed {permissions:['read']}, or DELETE, or DELETE then POST with adoptHome:true
instructions: scratch/run.ts <downgrade|delete|recreate> boots the app in-process in the sandbox, enables antivirus against a pausing fake clamd, starts the unzip, changes the account once the scan is reached, releases the scan and prints status and tree
execution.observed_result: 2 of 2 runs per variant: downgrade, delete and delete+recreate(adoptHome) all returned unzip 200 with p/a.txt and p/b.txt landed; control unzip after downgrade 403; new account usage read 0 (not charged at that read).

remediation.strategy: Run the current() check of PUT /api/content (findUser, createdAt, need(write), quotaUserOf) after the gate loop and before mkdirSync(landed); release the hold and refuse on mismatch; commit against the re-resolved quota owner.

likelihood.reason: needs antivirus on, an admin change inside the scan window

impact.reason: a revoked or deleted account's in-flight request writes up to the unzip budget into its own former/orphaned home; no other user's data is read or changed

confidence.reason: reproduced 2 of 2 per variant with a 403 control
